elevate.move: Implement the DrawSVG brass connector line animation from concept.json so the room-marker rail draws progressively on scroll, giving the signature system its promised kinetic identity instead of relying solely on CSS transitions.

Transform the EV charger estimator output from a plain price range into a designed cost-breakdown card using the arch-frame primitive and room-marker language, so the tool's answer feels like part of the bungalow tour rather than a generic calculator.
